title: FIELD CADVALUE emission preflight
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated ASCII/Binary controls
scope: Make FIELD CADVALUE checks reject payloads that the selected DXF sinks cannot safely encode
Ensure malformed root and child values fail before the FIELD record prefix
Keep valid FIELD wire output and version profiles unchanged

evidence.sourceObservation: writeField performs a whole-field admission check before emitting its prefix. The admission helper previously checked variant kinds but not non-finite doubles/coordinates or a null public string carrier; writer sinks reject non-finite doubles, while DRW_Variant::c_str() dereferences content.s.

implementation.summary: FIELD CADVALUE preflight now rejects non-finite scalar values, null STRING carriers, non-finite XY/XYZ coordinates according to data type, and binary lengths larger than INT_MAX before narrowing to the DXF length group.
implementation.wireBehaviorDetail: Malformed caller-provided CADVALUEs now fail before any direct FIELD bytes are emitted. Valid sink encodings are unchanged.

asciiAndBinaryNegative: Root data-type-2 NaN is rejected with no output.
Root data-type-32 infinite Z is rejected with no output.
Child data-type-4 STRING with a null content.s carrier is rejected with no output and no dereference.
Child data-type-2 negative infinity is rejected with no output.
generatedControls.oversizedBinaryLengthControl: The INT_MAX guard is source-verified; no multi-gigabyte vector was allocated for a test.

results.diffCheck: passed after the plan/receipt changes; git diff --check on scoped implementation and plan files returned success

assessment.localMismatchFound: FIELD preflight admitted a non-finite payload or null STRING carrier based only on variant type. A later typed sink could reject after FIELD prefix emission, and the public DRW_Variant content pointer could be dereferenced.
assessment.claim: The covered malformed FIELD CADVALUE payloads now fail during the existing whole-field preflight before any output; the null child string case is rejected without dereference.
assessment.limitations: This does not establish all FIELD schema semantics, object-reference closure, native CAD acceptance, enormous-allocation behavior, or complete FIELD/DWG support. The oversized binary-length guard is not exercised with an allocation above INT_MAX.
